pyramiding_rule: Strictly prohibit adding volume to a position until the base trade achieves a minimum +$2.50 floating profit and structural trailing stop covers execution commission.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a minimum 30-second multi-orderbook imbalance confirmation and structural ATR buffer (> $0.75 away from current tick) before assigning stop-loss orders.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing stops or partial lock-ins as soon as profit crosses +$3.00 to guarantee asymmetric outcomes targeting $15-$30+ runners.
